name: Octree-based Volume Rendering with Wavelet Leaves
definition: A volume rendering technique using an octree data structure for space subdivision, where leaf nodes store volume data in a multi-resolution wavelet format to enable efficient traversal, early termination, and progressive refinement.
summary: Octree-based Volume Rendering with Wavelet Leaves renders large volumetric datasets on distributed clusters by using 3D Haar wavelets in leaf nodes for incremental loading and frustum-clipping memory management.
